However, traditional OCR systems face significant limitations as the world grows increasingly multilingual and dependent on handwritten and visually structured content. sources.title: RolmOCR: Document OCR Model for Recognizing Handwritten and Slanted ...
sources.snippet: RolmOCR is an open source OCR tool to quickly extract text from images and PDFs , built on the Qwen2.5-VL-7B model , no dependence on metadata , low memory footprint , support for handwritten and skewed documents , free for users to use and modify .

sources.title: Reducto AI Released RolmOCR: A SoTA OCR Model Built on...
sources.snippet: RolmOCR, a state-of-the-art OCR model developed by Reducto AI, leverages the powerful vision-language model Qwen 2.5 VL to understand and process multilingual and complexly structured documents. It supports both printed and handwritten recognition across multiple languages and visually intricate layouts.
